hero.headline: Draw the play. Run the play.
hero.subheadline: Draw half-court sets, screens and cuts, then animate the movement so your team sees exactly where to be.

value.title: Built for how basketball actually spaces the floor
value.description: Five dots frozen on a whiteboard can't show a screen, a cut or the defense rotating. Pulse Tactical can.
points: Draw half-court sets with real spacing, from Horns to a low 1-4
Show screens, cuts and handoffs, not just where players stand
Animate inbound plays so the timing is clear before tip-off

plays.name: Pick & Roll
plays.description: Ball-handler drives off the screen, the big rolls to the rim as the defense rotates.

plays.name: Horns
plays.description: Two bigs at the elbows, guard attacks the middle off a pindown or dribble handoff.

plays.name: Motion Offense
plays.description: Continuous cuts and screens away from the ball until the defense breaks.

plays.name: Baseline Inbound
plays.description: Stack under the rim, first cut clears for the shooter curling off a double screen.

features: Screen and cut arrows (picks, curls, handoffs)
Animate possessions frame by frame, adjustable speed
GIF export & share with the roster
